summary.en: Desktop client that runs many AI coding agent threads in one window, with sub-agent orchestration and phone remote control.
summary.zh-CN: AI 编码桌面客户端：一个窗口管理多个 AI coding agent 线程，支持编排子代理与手机远程控制。

description.en: A pure Go desktop app drawn with MyGo's native UI, no cgo. It runs Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and many other CLI agents as threads in one window, with a timeline, composer, kanban, terminal, Git changes and cross-session search. A lead agent can split work across sub-agents. A bundled web client takes over the same sessions from a phone. macOS first; Windows is best effort.
description.zh-CN: 纯 Go 桌面应用，界面由 MyGo 原生绘制，不依赖 cgo。在一个窗口里以线程形式运行 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 等多种 CLI agent，内置会话时间线、Composer、看板、终端、Git 变更和跨会话搜索；主代理可把任务拆给子代理并行完成；附带 Web 远程端，可在手机上接管同一批会话。以 macOS 为主，Windows 尽力支持。
